newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Fortis launches employee option plan.
newsitem.headline: Fortis launches employee option plan.

text.p: Fortis Amev said on Wednesday that it and Fortis Nederland planned to launch an option plan for all its permanent employees of Fortis in the Netherlands, but the plan did not involve the issuance of new shares.
"The total number of options to be offered to employees will be 2.3 million," Fortis said in a statement.
This adds to the 275,000 shares to be offered under an expanded Management Option Plan.

"There will be no dilution of the earnings per share for existing shareholders because Fortis Amev will purchase.. the shares that are eventually taken up.. We expect this to be around one percent of the outstanding share capital," chairman Hans Bartelds said.
Options may be exercised during a period of five years from July 1, 1997, at a price equal to the closing price on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange on that date.
